Title: Max Request Length Samples for Marketing APIs

Blocks.Section: Max Request Length Samples for Marketing APIs
Blocks.Text: Warning

Blocks.Section: Max Request Length Samples for Marketing APIs
Blocks.Text:
Deprecation Notice:
The Marketing Version 202510 (Marketing October 2025) will be sunset on October 15, 2026. We recommend that you migrate to the latest versioned APIs to avoid disruptions. For information on all the supported versions, refer to the migrations documentation.
If you haven’t yet migrated and have questions, submit a request on the LinkedIn Developer Support Portal.

Blocks.Section: Max Request Length Samples for Marketing APIs
Blocks.Text: LinkedIn will begin rejecting API calls not meeting new length requirements. Requests exceeding these limits must be adjusted and use query tunneling. This page provides sample API requests re-constructed to use query tunneling for Marketing APIs. This page is not designed to be a comprehensive list of all possible examples. If the API you are using is not mentioned on this page, please refer to the other API examples to re-construct your API call. Query tunneling is supported for all APIs.

Blocks.Section: Max Request Length Samples for Marketing APIs
Blocks.Text: See the Migration Guide - Updated API Request Maximum Length for the full summary of these changes.
